name: ai-architectures
description: House plans, floor plans and AI-drawn CAD drawings (DXF, DWG, PDF) from a description or a sketch, inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
AI Architectures brings floor plans, house plans and CAD drawings into the conversation.

Search a library of about 500 ready-made house plans (ranch, farmhouse, barndominium, ADU, cabin, tiny house, duplex, two-storey, small homes and more) by bedrooms, bathrooms, size, storeys and garage. Each house design comes with a floor plan image, room sizes and downloadable PDF, DXF, IFC and GLB (3D model) files.

See CAD floor plans drawn by the AI drafter of the Plan Chat studio, each with the brief it was drawn from and a DXF file.

Connect your AI Architectures account to have the drafter draw a new architectural drawing: a layered, dimensioned CAD floor plan from a description, or sketch to CAD from a hand sketch or a photo of a plan that you attach (walls, doors, windows, furniture, dimension chains, room names and areas). Check its progress and preview, change it in plain words, and download DXF, DWG and PDF for AutoCAD and other CAD programs. New drawings and changes use the credits of your AI Architectures account, the same as on the website. You can also open any drawing in the Plan Chat studio to edit it with CAD tools or view it in 3D.

For photo-based home design tools (remodel previews on a photo of your home, photoreal renders from sketches, virtual staging), it links the right page on ai-architectures.com.

Intended for homeowners, builders, designers, architects and drafters who need a quick floor plan, a house blueprint to discuss, or a clean CAD base drawing. Plans and drawings are design concepts, not permit or construction documents; have a licensed professional review them before building.
defaultPrompt: Find a 3 bedroom ranch house plan under 2,000 sq ft with a garage.
Draw a CAD floor plan of a 120 m² single-storey house with 3 bedrooms.
Show me CAD floor plans drawn by the AI drafter.

positive.description: Search the house plan library with filters (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: Find a 3 bedroom ranch house plan under 2,000 sq ft with a garage.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a carousel of matching plans (3 bedrooms, at most 2,000 sq ft, with garage), each with a floor plan image, size facts and buttons to the plan page with PDF/DXF downloads and to change it in the CAD studio. The text answer lists the plans with links.

positive.description: Open one plan with all its downloads.
positive.prompt: Show me the details and the DXF of the small 3 bedroom ranch house plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the plan card with its description, room facts and download links for the PDF plan set, the DXF per level, IFC and GLB.

positive.description: Show CAD drawings made by the AI drafter.
positive.prompt: Show me some CAD floor plans the AI Architectures drafter has drawn.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows published CAD drawings with previews, the brief each was drawn from, a DXF download and a link to draw a similar one in the studio.

positive.description: Draw a new CAD floor plan on the connected account (sign in with the reviewer account when asked).
positive.prompt: Draw a CAD floor plan of a single-storey family house, about 120 m²: 3 bedrooms, open kitchen and living, one bathroom, single garage.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming the brief, starts a drawing and returns its id and studio link; get_cad_drawing reports progress and, after 1 to 5 minutes, status ready with a preview image, the drafter's notes, room labels and DXF, DWG and PDF links (valid 10 minutes).

positive.description: Change an existing drawing in words.
positive.prompt: In my AI Architectures drawing, make the kitchen 4.2 m wide and add a window to bedroom 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the drawing, sends the change, and after a minute or two shows the new version with an updated preview and file links. Earlier versions stay available in the studio.

negative.description: Permit or construction documents are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Make me stamped construction drawings for my building permit.

negative.description: Deleting drawings or account data is not supported in the app.
negative.prompt: Delete all my AI Architectures drawings.

negative.description: No purchases or plan changes inside ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my AI Architectures subscription to the Pro plan.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Account tools use the existing credits of the user's own AI Architectures account; when credits are missing it says so and links the informational pricing page.

publication.release_notes: Listing text only: the description, short description and keywords now name more of the jobs the app already does (floor plans, sketch to CAD, architectural drawings, house design, tiny houses and cabins in the plan library). No tool changes.

de-DE.subtitle: Hauspläne und CAD-Zeichnungen
de-DE.description: AI Architectures bringt Grundrisse und CAD-Zeichnungen in den Chat: rund 500 fertige Hauspläne mit PDF-, DXF-, IFC- und GLB-Dateien durchsuchen, CAD-Grundrisse des KI-Zeichners ansehen und mit verbundenem Konto neue bemaßte CAD-Grundrisse zeichnen lassen, per Text ändern und als DXF, DWG und PDF herunterladen. Entwürfe, keine Bau- oder Einreichpläne.
